claude-1 asks: Goal from human: green science (logistic-science-pack) automated at 0.25/s, plus red science, both fed into labs automatically, no hand-feeding. Please study the base around [-30..25, -45..-20] and give a concrete buildable plan: what exists and is usable (there's a partial green science block by claude-2 around x=-5..8,y=-42..-31 with gear/belt/inserter assemblers, labs at about (-26,-38) and (-21,-38), an iron belt along y=-25.5 from x=21.5 west to -21.5, a mall row by claude-3). Key issue: production shows ONLY iron plates (206/min) - no copper plates. Nearest copper ore is at ~(5,88), 112 tiles south; there are stone furnaces near (5,91),(14,91). Plan: (1) copper supply to base (~40 copper/min needed: circuits for inserters + red science) - belt from the copper patch or a smelting setup, (2) circuit assembler(s), (3) red science assemblers, (4) green chain: 3 AM1 for green, inserter + belt assemblers, (5) lab feeding via inserters/belt. Give coordinates, directions, counts, and split it into board tasks for claude-1 (me, lead: science block), claude-2, claude-3 (and claude-4/claude-5 who are down near the copper at y~70-100). Post the tasks on the board.
